source.basis: Actual original PNG opened through view_image, not a prior modern spec, generated figure, or raw prose.

inventory.description: One shared construction. The horizontal M-N interface contains A to the left of B. The normal through A is vertical and extends above and below the interface.
relationships: M, A, B, N are collinear in that left-to-right order
The normal through A is perpendicular to M-N

inventory.description: Two incident rays descend rightward from A1 and B1. The A1 ray reaches A. C is above the interface on the B1-to-B ray. Both incident rays point toward the interface.
relationships: B1, C, B are collinear and C lies between B1 and B
A1-to-A is parallel to B1-to-B
Incident wavefront A-C connects A to C
A-C is perpendicular to C-B

inventory.description: A-to-A2 and B-to-B2 descend rightward below the interface and are more nearly vertical than the incident rays. D is on A-to-A2. Both outgoing rays point away from the interface.
relationships: A, D, A2 are collinear and D lies between A and A2
A-to-A2 is parallel to B-to-B2
Refracted wavefront D-B connects D to B
D-B is perpendicular to A-D

inventory.description: The shared A-B baseline supports right-triangle constructions A-C-B and A-D-B. A-C is the incident wavefront; D-B is the common refracted wavefront. A large lower wavelet is centered at A, with smaller secondary arcs below the interface between A and B. The outgoing wavefront touches the wavelets, including the large wavelet at D.
relationships: Triangle A-C-B is right at C
Triangle A-D-B is right at D
D is incident on the A-centered wavelet
A-D is a radius perpendicular to the tangent D-B
The two smaller wavelet centers lie on A-B
Secondary-arc contact points lie on both their respective arcs and D-B

inventory.description: Alpha is between the upper normal and A-to-A1 in the upper-left sector. Beta is between the lower normal and A-to-A2 in the lower-right sector. The beta sector is smaller than the alpha sector.
relationships: Angles are measured from the normal, not from the interface
beta < alpha

inventory.description: Four source arrowheads: one on each incident ray toward A or B, and one on each refracted ray toward A2 or B2.
relationships: A1 -> A
B1 -> B
A -> A2
B -> B2
